svg.text: One architecture, twelve treatments. Sheet 01 found the era; this sheet hunts the voice. The building never changes — only the charm does.
row 1 isolates the axes · row 2 climbs the ladder · row 3 changes the kind of play
the language as delivered — the yardstick, not a contender
walls gain weight; plinth, fascia, chimney and canopy thicken
the roof becomes the character — deep eaves, soft edges, big fascia
bigger glass, wider door, deeper canopy — the house gets a face
the brief's 10–15% push, all axes at once
past the brief on purpose — testing the ceiling
too far, deliberately — you find the line by crossing it
nothing quite parallel; ridge sags, chimney off plumb — built by hands
walls belly outward, edges melt — the loaf-of-bread reading
accent stops being a garnish: door, awning, barge, garage
a dark drawn line joins the language; the sheet becomes a picture book
proportion · roof generosity · opening size · entrance friendliness · colour spend · softness of edge · orthogonal perfection

LEAD’S READ — the voice lives between S-06 and S-07, carried by S-09’s hand: charm in the +20/+30 band, with the wobble’s built-by-hands imperfection on top. S-08 proves the ceiling; S-10 and S-12 are lovely but belong to different games.
SHEET 01 FOUND THE ERA · SHEET 02 HUNTS THE VOICE
the winning voice is then verified across all twelve buildings of Sheet 01 before anything locks
